name: Editor
description: Worktree-scoped file editing, recovery, search and explorer services.

method.description: Save an untitled Markdown buffer to a new authorized relative path, preserving its buffer and tab identity. Never replaces an existing destination.

result.description: The saved and retargeted editor buffer info; untitled is false. A stale revision, existing destination or non-untitled buffer fails without losing either file.

method.description: Read Markdown review notes across a worktree, including closed buffers, or settle exact delivered/cleared snapshots. Canonical notes remain editor-owned.

path.description: Optional worktree-relative path filter for list.

items.description: Exact note object returned by list; every persisted field must still match before deletion.

result.description: list returns {notes: MarkdownReviewNote[]}; settle returns {deletedNoteIds:string[],retainedNoteIds:string[]}. Changed snapshots survive; another worktree is never modified.

method.description: Open an authorized worktree file in an editor tab.

path.description: Required non-empty worktree-relative path; an authorized absolute path is also accepted.

preview.description: Open as the replaceable Explorer preview tab.

focus.description: Focus the new tab; defaults false for API callers.

group.description: Non-empty terminal tab group when supplied.

matchLength.description: UTF-16 selection length, at most 52,428,800 code units; supplying it requires both line and column.

openedTabId.description: Stable terminal tab ID created or reused by this open call.

content.description: Optional inline UTF-8 text within the aggregate 256 KiB content budget.

draft.description: Draft text when present, or null when clean; a non-null draft may be omitted when it is lazy.

baseline.description: Saved-content baseline hash, or null when no saved baseline is available.

external.description: External disk state: 'changed', 'deleted', or null when there is no external change.

diskContent.description: Optional inline disk comparison text within the aggregate 256 KiB content budget, or null when unavailable.

diskSignature.description: Disk content signature, or null when no comparison signature is available.

diskContentLength.description: Nonnegative disk-content length when present, or null when no disk comparison is available.

diskContentBytes.description: Nonnegative disk-content byte count when present, or null when no disk comparison is available.

draftLength.description: Nonnegative draft length when present, or null when there is no draft.

draftBytes.description: Nonnegative draft UTF-8 byte count when present, or null when there is no draft.

tabId.description: Stable terminal tab ID, or null when no editor tab is mapped.

error.description: Error message, or null when this buffer has no error.

method.description: Read the editor's authoritative buffers, terminal tab mappings and per-worktree state.

baseline.description: Saved-content baseline hash, or null when no saved baseline is available.

draftLength.description: Nonnegative draft length when present, or null when there is no draft.

draftBytes.description: Nonnegative draft UTF-8 byte count when present, or null when there is no draft.

diskContentLength.description: Nonnegative disk-content length when present, or null when no disk comparison is available.

external.description: External disk state: 'changed', 'deleted', or null when there is no external change.

tabId.description: Stable terminal tab ID, or null when no editor tab is mapped.

error.description: Error message, or null when this buffer has no error.

search.description: Either null when no contents search state is active, or an object with worktreeId (string), query (string), loading (boolean), error (string or null), files (array of {path:string, relativePath:string, matches:array of {line:integer >= 1, column:integer >= 1, matchLength:integer >= 0, lineContent:string, and optional displayColumn:integer >= 1 and displayMatchLength:integer >= 0}, and optional matchCount:nonnegative integer}), totalMatches (nonnegative integer), truncated (boolean), and requestId (string or null).

method.description: CAS-update a shared editable buffer draft using its content revision.

content.description: Required UTF-8 draft text; the service rejects drafts larger than 50 MiB.
Optional inline text within the aggregate 256 KiB content budget.

draft.description: Draft text when present, or null when clean; a non-null draft may be omitted when it is lazy.

baseline.description: Saved-content baseline hash, or null when no saved baseline is available.

external.description: External disk state: 'changed', 'deleted', or null when there is no external change.

method.description: Save a draft with a content-hash baseline; overwrite is the only unguarded write.

draft.description: Draft text when present, or null when clean; a non-null draft may be omitted when it is lazy.

baseline.description: Saved-content baseline hash, or null when no saved baseline is available.

method.description: Close one actual editor tab, keeping previews draft-neutral and requiring a choice for dirty edits.
Terminal close guard for the actual editor tab; returns true only when closing cannot lose a draft.
Reopen the most recently closed eligible edit tab, or return null when the stack is empty.

result.description: Either null when no eligible recently closed edit tab exists, or an editor-buffer snapshot with id/worktreeId/root/path/relativePath/name, kind, content, nullable draft and baseline, size/contentLength/contentBytes, nullable draftLength/draftBytes, readOnly/dirty, nullable external/diskContent/diskSignature/diskContentLength/diskContentBytes, mode/tabId, preview/pinned/untitled, revision/contentRevision, view and nullable error. kind is text, markdown, notebook, csv, image, pdf, audio, video, mermaid or binary; mode is source, rich or preview.

method.description: Update view state or resolve an external change while preserving guarded-save rules.

action.description: Optional; defaults to update. update applies patch/preview state; promote, pin, reveal, compare, reload, keep and undoReload select their named operation and need no patch.

scroll.description: Either a nonnegative numeric scroll position or a viewer-specific structured scroll-state object.

search.description: Search state as a string or viewer-specific object.

find.description: Find state as a string or viewer-specific object.

sort.description: Sort state as a string or viewer-specific object.

filter.description: Filter state as a string or viewer-specific object.

mode.description: Preview is a separate tab and cannot be set through a buffer mode patch.

markdownAnchor.description: Either a safe Markdown heading fragment of at most 512 UTF-8 bytes or null; empty string and null clear it.

content.description: Optional inline text within the aggregate 256 KiB content budget.

draft.description: Draft text when present, or null when clean; a non-null draft may be omitted when it is lazy.

baseline.description: Saved-content baseline hash, or null when no saved baseline is available.

external.description: External disk state: 'changed', 'deleted', or null when there is no external change.

diskContent.description: Optional inline disk comparison text, or null when unavailable.

diskSignature.description: Disk content signature, or null when no comparison signature is available.

diskContentLength.description: Nonnegative disk-content length when present, or null when no disk comparison is available.

diskContentBytes.description: Nonnegative disk-content byte count when present, or null when no disk comparison is available.

draftLength.description: Nonnegative draft length when present, or null when there is no draft.

draftBytes.description: Nonnegative draft UTF-8 byte count when present, or null when there is no draft.

tabId.description: Stable terminal tab ID, or null when no editor tab is mapped.

error.description: Error message, or null when this buffer has no error.

method.description: List and refresh authorized directory entries, filter the inventory, reveal paths and update per-worktree preferences.

action.description: reveal uses path when supplied; filter uses query; preferences accepts showDotfiles, displayRoot and expanded. list/refresh accept an optional directory path.

path.description: Directory to list/refresh or path to reveal; required to reveal a specific path.

query.description: Filter query, limited by the service to 2,048 UTF-8 bytes.

items.description: Worktree path to expand; the service retains only authorized directories.

method.description: Create, rename, move, duplicate, Trash-delete or import worktree files, rekeying open buffers atomically.

action.description: rename/move require newPath. import requires at least one sourcePaths or files entry; every imported source is copied into the destination with a collision-safe name, even when it is already inside the worktree.

newPath.description: Required non-empty destination for rename and move.

content.description: Optional initial UTF-8 file content; createFile is limited to 50 MiB.

sourcePaths.description: Import source paths; sourcePaths and files together accept at most 256 files, 256 KiB of path/name metadata, and 50 MiB of file data. Sources are copied, including same-worktree sources, using collision-safe destination names.

items.description: Non-empty source file or directory path to copy into the destination.

files.description: Inline import files; at most 256 entries across sourcePaths and files, 256 KiB of metadata and 50 MiB of total file data.

name.description: Required safe, non-empty filename without path separators.

data.description: Canonical Base64-encoded file bytes, at most 69,905,068 characters for a 50 MiB file; the service validates encoding and enforces the 50 MiB per-file and aggregate import byte limits.

path.description: Created, moved, duplicated, deleted, or import destination worktree path.

buffer.description: Optional complete editor buffer snapshot; its fields and nullable values match the buffer snapshot documented on open's result.

paths.description: Paths created by an import; non-empty for import results.

method.description: Inspect or apply owner- and destination-guarded undo/redo operations.
Search the bounded rg file inventory, rank fuzzy matches and manage worktree-scoped recents.

action.description: record requires path; search accepts query (empty is allowed); history and clearHistory need no further fields.

query.description: Optional fuzzy path query, limited to 2,048 UTF-8 bytes by the service.

path.description: Required for record; the path must resolve to a file, not a directory.

method.description: Run, cancel or inspect a bounded contents search in an authorized worktree.

action.description: run starts or replaces the worktree search; cancel and state operate on that worktree's current search and need no query or requestId.

query.description: Optional search query; empty query produces an empty result. Query, includePattern and excludePattern are each limited to 8,192 UTF-8 bytes.

includePattern.description: Optional include glob, limited to 8,192 UTF-8 bytes.

excludePattern.description: Optional exclude glob, limited to 8,192 UTF-8 bytes.

requestId.description: Optional caller-chosen ID for a run; the service creates one when omitted.

error.description: Error message, or null when there is no search error.

requestId.description: Active search request ID, or null when no request is active.

method.description: Read a buffer, bounded bytes, or revisioned UTF-16 text chunks from an authorized open buffer.

action.description: buffer needs only bufferId/action. bytes accepts optional offset/length (defaults to 0/1 MiB). text requires kind, offset and contentRevision; kind=disk additionally requires the current diskSignature.

offset.description: Byte offset for bytes or UTF-16 code-unit offset for text; text requires this value and bytes defaults it to 0.

length.description: Bytes reads accept up to 1 MiB; text reads accept up to 65,536 UTF-16 code units. Omitted values default to the action's maximum.

kind.description: Required for text reads; disk reads also require diskSignature.

contentRevision.description: Required for text reads and must match the buffer's current content revision.

diskSignature.description: Required for kind=disk text reads and must match the current disk comparison signature.

result.description: Action-dependent result union: buffer returns a complete editor-buffer snapshot with eof=true and size; bytes returns Base64 data/eof/size; text returns a UTF-16 text chunk with offset/nextOffset/eof/contentRevision and diskSignature only for kind=disk. Text chunks are at most 65,536 code units and byte reads at most 1 MiB.

buffer.description: Complete editor-buffer snapshot documented on open's result.

data.description: Base64-encoded bytes for a bounded on-disk range.

offset.description: UTF-16 code-unit offset for text results.

nextOffset.description: Next UTF-16 code-unit offset for text results.

eof.description: Always true for buffer results; otherwise indicates whether the selected range reached end-of-file/text.

method.description: Stage and commit bounded draft, create-file or import uploads. The service allows at most four active transfers and 100 MiB of total staging; idle transfers expire after five minutes.

action.description: begin requires kind and totalBytes; kind=draft additionally requires bufferId and expectedRevision, kind=createFile requires path, and kind=import requires path and name. chunk requires transferId, offset and data. commit/cancel/state require transferId.

kind.description: Required for begin; selects the draft, create-file or import transfer branch.

path.description: Required for createFile/import begin; import path must be a destination directory.

name.description: Required non-empty safe filename for import begin.

totalBytes.description: Required on begin; total upload size, at most 50 MiB.

data.description: Required for chunk; canonical Base64 encoding of 1–65,536 bytes (at most 87,384 Base64 characters), checked by the service.

result.description: Action-dependent result union. begin returns transferId, offset:0 and maxChunkBytes:65,536; chunk returns transferId/offset/nextOffset; cancel returns transferId/cancelled; state returns transferId/kind/offset/totalBytes/expiresAt/progress. commit returns a complete editor-buffer snapshot for draft, {path} for createFile, or {path,paths} for import.

offset.description: Zero on begin; current staged-byte offset on other transfer results.

maxChunkBytes.description: Fixed maximum decoded chunk size in bytes.

kind.description: Transfer kind for state results; file kind when commit returns a buffer snapshot.

path.description: Created-file path, import destination, or buffer path for a draft commit.

paths.description: Imported paths for an import commit.

method.description: Source-preserving Markdown capabilities, edits, links, templates, search, TOC and export.

bufferId.description: Required for every action except new and templates.

expectedRevision.description: Required for apply, format, insert, replace, link edit/remove and importImage operations that write content.

worktree.description: Optional worktree selector for new and templates.

action.description: apply requires expectedRevision and text. format requires expectedRevision, format and selection; insert requires expectedRevision and format, with selection optional. links uses operation; edit/remove require selection and expectedRevision, and all link operations except remove require target. search requires query; replace requires expectedRevision, non-empty query (at most 2 KiB UTF-8) and text. importImage requires expectedRevision and either name+data, an authorized path, or the native chooser; exportPdf requires rich/preview mode and source at most 600 KiB UTF-8, with an optional destination path. new creates named files; untitled creation and Save As are not exposed in this release. new/templates use worktree and optional title/template/query; other buffer actions require bufferId.

query.description: Search, template or document query. replace and documents queries are limited to 2 KiB UTF-8; replace also requires a non-empty query.

text.description: Required by apply and replace; resulting rich apply/format/insert content is limited to 1 MiB UTF-8. Also supplies optional replacement text, code or image alt text for relevant formats.

format.description: Required for format/insert; insert accepts insertion formats only. Details, collapsible headings and custom document-link insertion are not published until their rich round trips are supported; use Source for those constructs.

target.description: Required for link operations other than remove and for link/image/document-link formats; interpreted as an authorized Markdown target.

path.description: Optional authorized image source or PDF destination for importImage/exportPdf.

title.description: Optional new-document title; the service uses at most 256 characters.

template.description: Optional worktree-relative Markdown template for new; template paths are at most 64 KiB UTF-8 and expanded content is at most 256 KiB.

selection.description: Markdown body offsets; required for format, link edit/remove and optional for insert/image insertion.

all.description: For replace, replace all matches when true.

openAnyway.description: For supported rich edits, allows source documents up to 1 MiB UTF-8 instead of the normal 600 KiB eligibility limit; committed rich text remains capped at 1 MiB.

includeCanonical.description: Include canonical Markdown text in capabilities when available.

includePreview.description: Include a sanitized preview when capabilities report one available.

visible.description: Set TOC or frontmatter visibility for toc/frontmatter actions.

releaseImages.description: For capabilities, release previously created Markdown image resources when true.

operation.description: Optional links operation; edit/remove require selection and a current revision, while open/copy/resolve resolve the target.

language.description: Optional code-block language label; when used it is limited to 32 letters, digits, underscore, plus or hyphen characters.

name.description: Required safe single filename when importImage supplies inline data.

data.description: Canonical Base64 image data for importImage, limited to 12 MiB of Base64 characters; larger images use transfer.

result.description: Action-dependent object union. new returns {buffer: full editor-buffer snapshot, path, template:string|null, templateCreated}; expanded templates are limited to 256 KiB. templates returns up to 100 {relativePath,name,title} entries plus total/truncated. capabilities returns bufferId/mode, rich and preview eligibility/reasons/byte limits (600 KiB rich, 1 MiB openAnyway, 8 MiB preview), optional canonicalText and sanitized preview data, and frontMatter either null or {text,startLine,endLine,lineCount,visible}; releaseImages returns {bufferId,released:true}. apply/format/insert edits return a buffer snapshot with change/source-preservation fields; format=copyCode returns {text,contentRevision}. links resolution returns {target,href:string|null,safe,resolved:string|null,ambiguous,kind,anchor:string|null,missing?}; link edits return an edit result. documents returns up to 20,000 {relativePath,name,title} entries with an 8 MiB aggregate path budget, total and truncated. toc returns {headings,count,visible}; frontmatter returns {visible,text,startLine/endLine nullable,readOnly}. search returns {query,matches,total,truncated,activeIndex} with at most 10,000 matches; replace returns {replacements,changed,buffer} and source-preservation data when changed. importImage returns {buffer,relativePath,mimeType,size,inserted} or {cancelled:true}; exportPdf returns exported path/details with valid:true,cancelled:false or {cancelled:true}. Nested buffers are full editor-buffer snapshots documented on open's result.

method.description: Persist, format, copy and send Markdown review notes.

bufferId.description: Required Markdown buffer; review notes are limited to Markdown buffers whose source is at most 8 MiB.

action.description: add requires selection and text; edit requires noteId and text; delete requires noteId. copy/send optionally accept noteIds. send accepts target existing with sessionId or target new with agent; an omitted target or missing associated field returns delivery:not-delivered with an error.

text.description: Required for add/edit; non-empty after trimming and limited to 16 KiB UTF-8.

selection.description: Required for add. Use non-empty from/to offsets; mode=source addresses the full source, while the default/rich mode addresses the Markdown body after frontmatter. Rich mode may instead supply text with startLine/endLine. The selected excerpt is limited to 32 KiB UTF-8.

noteIds.description: Optional subset of note IDs for copy/send; omitted selects all available notes.

target.description: Optional for send; existing requires sessionId and new requires agent. Omission returns a not-delivered result.

sessionId.description: Required when sending to target existing.

agent.description: Required when sending to target new; optional when target existing to verify session ownership.

result.description: Action-dependent result union. list returns notes/count; add/edit return note; delete returns deleted/noteId; copy returns text/count/noteIds; send returns delivery/deletedNoteIds/retainedNoteIds and optional sessionId/error.

deleted.description: Always true for a successful delete action.

method.description: Parse and edit notebook cells, inspect environments, manage trust and run the local kernel. Install/venv actions use a conditional setup confirmation.
method.confirm: Set up the requested local notebook environment?

action.description: All actions require bufferId. parse uses paging fields. edit/delete/type/move/run require index; edit also requires source, insert requires index/position/cellType, move uses direction, and clear's index is optional. describe requires path or python; select accepts an interpreter path/python or browse; environments accepts runWorkspaceInterpreters; trust accepts granted. install/venv use conditional setup confirmation. run requires index; runAll does not; mode controls run advancement.

index.description: Required for edit/insert/move/delete/type/run; optional for clear.

outputLimit.description: For parse, output page size; service requires at least 1 and caps at 8.

yes.description: Explicit CLI approval consumed by the dispatcher before this handler.

browse.description: Open the native Python chooser; cancellation leaves the current interpreter unchanged.

result.description: Action-dependent object union. parse returns a paged notebook document {valid,error:string|null,language:string|null,nbformat:integer|null,nbformat_minor:integer|null,metadata,cellCount,contentRevision,offset,limit,cells,nextOffset:integer|null,eof}; invalid documents instead return {valid:false,error,language,cellCount,contentRevision,rawSource,rawSourceLength,rawSourceOffset,rawSourceNextOffset:integer|null,rawSourceTruncated}. Each parsed cell contains cell_type,id?,metadata,source,sourceOffset,sourceTotalLength,sourceNextOffset:integer|null,sourceTruncated,outputs,outputCount,outputOffset,outputNextOffset:integer|null,outputsTruncated and execution_count?; metadata and output entries are arbitrary objects or {truncated:true,byteLength}, and output text may be a string or string array. state returns {bufferId,valid,cellCount,language:string|null,error:string|null,contentRevision,trusted,selectedPython,busy,executionCount:integer|null,interruptStalled,kernel:{status,pid?,stderr,error:string|null,executionCount:integer|null,busy}}. Cell edits return the parse page; save returns a full editor-buffer snapshot. environments returns {environments:[interpreter descriptors],probed}; describe returns {environment}; select returns {selected:true,environment,trusted,language} or {cancelled:true,selected:interpreter|null}; trust returns {trusted}. install returns {status:installed,environment,command} or {status:venv-required,error}; venv returns {status:created,path,environment,command}; start returns {status:ready,python,pid}, {status:failed,error}, or {status:missing-ipykernel,externallyManaged}. run/runAll return {status:ok|error|dead|missing-ipykernel|failed,completed:nonnegative integer,cancelled:nonnegative integer,executionCount:integer|null}; run may also include outputCount and nextIndex (when mode=advance), and either action may include stderr/externallyManaged. interrupt returns {interrupted,stalled}; restart returns {status:stopped,trusted:false,outputsKept:true,queueCancelled:true}; shutdown returns {status:stopped,trusted:boolean}.

method.description: Read and edit CSV data and control file-viewer state using ranged reads. File previews are limited to 50 MiB; CSVs at least 1 MiB use read-only paged mode.

action.description: edit requires row/column/value; insertRow accepts optional index/count; deleteRow requires row or index; insertColumn/deleteColumn require index; delimiter requires one non-quote, non-line-break character; paste requires row/column/text. sort requires column or index and order; filter/find accept query; zoom requires scale; position requires page or offset. page, metadata, save and media need no additional fields.

count.description: Optional CSV page row count; service clamps it to 1–100 rows.

value.description: CSV cell value or optional inserted header value.

text.description: Paste text; UTF-8 payload must remain below 1 MiB.

query.description: Filter/find query, limited to 8,192 characters by the service.

delimiter.description: For delimiter action, exactly one character other than quote or a line break.

scale.description: Required for zoom; service clamps PDF to 0.25–5 and other viewers to 0.25–8.

page.description: Optional page number; CSV pages are zero-based, PDF pages are one-based.

result.description: Action-dependent result union. save returns a full editor-buffer snapshot. metadata returns kind-specific viewer metadata: CSV, image, PDF/audio/video, Mermaid, binary or unsupported-file shapes. CSV mutations return CSV metadata; sort returns viewer state; filter returns {filter,paged,readOnly,view}. page returns a CSV page {page,rows:[{index,cells}],offset,nextPage:integer|null,totalRows?,delimiter?,readOnly,changedOnDisk,limits?}, PDF page position/contentType/readOnly, or image metadata; a changed CSV page can include an empty rows array and message. media returns {url,contentType,size,acceptsRanges:true}, or {changedOnDisk:true,error,size}. copy returns {text,rows}; zoom returns {zoom,minimum,maximum,view}; find returns {query,matches,truncated?,view}; position returns {position}. PDF zoom may be a number or the string page-width.

acceptsRanges.description: Always true for successful media resource results.

zoom.description: Numeric zoom level or the PDF metadata string page-width.

nextPage.description: Next CSV page number or null when there is no next page.

method.description: Resolve whether a notebook action requires irreversible environment setup confirmation.

params.description: The dispatcher forwards the original notebook params; this side-effect-free planner uses action, bufferId, path, and python and ignores the remaining fields.

bufferId.description: Required for install/venv confirmation; ignored for other actions.

action.description: install/venv require bufferId and return confirmation text; all other actions return null without resolving a buffer.

result.description: Confirmation text for install and venv; null for every other notebook action.

method.description: Open Find on the focused editor surface.

result.description: Surface-specific union: source {opened:true,query?}; rich Markdown {opened:true,replace:false,query?,total?}; notebook {opened:true} or {opened:true,query,matches,truncated}; CSV {opened:true} or {filtered:true,query}; PDF {opened:true} or {found,page,totalPages}.

method.description: Open Replace on the focused editor surface.

result.description: Surface-specific union: source {opened:true,query?}; rich/preview Markdown {opened:true,replace:true,query?,total?}.
